svg.title: Historical British Columbia coat of arms - revised vector reconstruction
svg.desc: Reconstructed from the user-supplied ornate historical coat of arms raster. Revised after enlarged comparisons of the antler interiors, scroll curls and seams, shield flag and small crown, sun ray curves, lion paws and crown jewels. Source-guided contours and selectively rebuilt geometry preserve the supplied drawing. Halftone dots and stray pixels are omitted. The motto is outlined: SPLENDOR SINE OCCASU. This is a reconstruction of the supplied drawing, not an authenticated official vector master.
